title: Admit or skip an eligible entry from the 10/50/90 quantiles of the t+1 open to t+5 close return
question: For an entry the current gate already allows, does admitting or skipping it by predicted 10/50/90 quantiles of the t+1 open to t+5 close return beat admit-all and cash on net return at equal capital, after costs, on identical splits? A tuned gradient-boosting baseline runs first; TFT is a challenger only if the baseline passes its gate.

dataset_manifest_sha256.pending: per-market point-in-time dataset from U2 (KR), U3 (US), U4 (crypto)

policy_version.pending: trading policy version the controls reproduce

features.pending: point-in-time feature list (every row carries available_at <= t) fixed with the U5 contract and the U2/U3/U4 datasets before any fit

labels.name: ret_open1_close5
labels.definition: return from the open of session t+1 to the close of session t+5; predicted as the 10/50/90 quantiles; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME when either price is missing

splits.scheme: expanding walk-forward on common dates per market: train 2015-2018 / validate 2019, adding one year per fold through validate 2022

exposure_audit.pending: audit that no earlier experiment, report or tuning run read 2023-2024 for this market; if exposed, a new manifest version switches to prospective_seal

test.seal_rule: opened once after the model is frozen; each opening is a registry test look

candidate_policies.description: current gate: every eligible entry is admitted
tuned gradient-boosting quantile model on identical inputs and splits; admit rule on the predicted quantiles fixed before the first fit (U7)
TFT quantile model on identical inputs and splits; runs only if gbm-baseline passes its gate (U8)

cost_table.pending: per-market cost table from the U5 evaluation contract

fill_models: volume share: quantity capped by a share of bar volume
empirical: fill rate calibrated on own order evidence

tuning_budget.pending: maximum configurations and search method fixed with U7 before the first fit; every configuration tried counts

seeds.pending: fixed with U7 before the first fit

metrics.primary: net return vs cash at equal capital, after costs, under the conservative fill model
secondary: quantile coverage and pinball loss (diagnostic only)
results under each of the four fill models

stopping_rules: if gbm-baseline fails its gate the ML track for this hypothesis stops; tft-challenger does not run
any leakage finding (available_at > t, preprocessing fitted outside the fold, test rows read before freeze) voids the run
the sealed test period is never reopened for this hypothesis after a look
no market-wide claim on a survivor-only universe
